acceptanceCriteria: In one clone, a stage-2 `dogfood begin` after a stage-1 seal either succeeds and keeps the stage-1 generation archived, or refuses with a documented next action.
A regression test covers begin after a satisfied, sealed enrollment whose target is an ancestor of HEAD.
docs/DOGFOOD.md describes the staged-binding route for over-cap batches.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session while binding the rc3 batch (beamfall/corvint#650 to #653) in three stages; installed corvint from PATH, go1.27.1, darwin arm64.

A batch over the 256-hunk or 256-obligation cap (V1-0394, V1-0522) must be bound in stages: bind and seal range BASE..M1, merge the next range, then bind M1-seal..M2. After stage 1 ended satisfied and sealed, `corvint dogfood begin --plan STAGE2 --session-key K` in the same clone refused with `{"code":"prior-completion-stale"}` (internal/localcompletion/lifecycle.go:77): the satisfied stage-1 enrollment is bound to its old target, so it no longer evaluates as satisfied once HEAD moves on. The refusal carries no next action. The only non-destructive route was a fresh clone for each stage; `dogfood cancel` would discard satisfied evidence. Expected: a sealed, satisfied enrollment whose target is an ancestor of HEAD is archived as a completed generation and lets the next stage begin, or the refusal names the supported route.

holds.reason: Owner decision: the earlier fix was reverted; a new design decision is needed.

title: dogfood begin refuses the next stage of a staged binding with prior-completion-stale in the same clone
